svg.title: The centered tensor is nonzero because its translation Ward charge differentiates a nonzero field. Compare its charges with those of Jraw. Field separation applied to every translation shell identity gives equality of their derivative families, Draw = cD. The weak derivative comparison then yields c/ξk →κ0, where κ0 ̸= 0 is the free stress Ward amplitude. Multiplying the preliminary raw stress limit by (c/ξk)−1 gives U−1 k,4(r4 k center(T)) −→κ−1 0 T 0. (PT13)
